translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: K'eesatuwaa Geeshshatetsaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda, «K'eesiyaa gidiyaa Aaroona attuma naanaatoo hawaadan yaagaade oda; ‹Hintteppe ooninne
bare mata dabbo, bare daay, bare aawuwaa, bare attuma na'aa, bare mac'c'a naatti, bare ishaa,
woy asinaa gelennaan, de'iyaa bare michchati anhaa gidana d'ayooppe, hayk'k'eedda asaa anhaa oowaanne bochchiide, barena tunissoppo.
K'ay akuwaaninne geluwaan dabboteedda asaa anhaa bochchiidekka barena tunissoppo.
« ‹K'eesetuu hayk'k'eeddawoo kayyottanaw barenttu huup'iyaa meedettoppino; barenttu buuchchaakka k'antsaan k'ans's'oppino; woy k'ay barenttu bollaakka k'ans's'ereetsoppino.

Unttunttu barenttu S'oossaw geeshsha gidino; k'ay barenttu S'oossaa suntsaakka tunissoppino. Ayaw gooppe unttunttu Med'inaa Godaw taman s'uugiide yarshshiyaa, k'umaa yarshshuwaa shiishshiyaawantta; hewaa diraw, unttunttu geeshsha gidanaw bessee.
« ‹K'aykka k'eesatuu sharmus'a mac'c'a asaa, wodorotetsay aketti diggeedda mac'c'a asaa, woy asinay yeddeedda mac'c'a asaa akkoppino. Ayaw gooppe, k'eesatuu barenttu S'oossaw geeshsha.
K'eesii hintte S'oossaw k'umaa yarshshuwaa shiishshiyaawaa gidiyaa diraw, I hara asaappe dummato. Taani hinttena geeshshiyaa hintte Med'inaa Goday geeshsha gidiyaa diraw, ikka geeshsha gido.
Ay k'eesiyaa naatto gidooppekka sharmus'aade barena tunissooppe, henna bare aawuwaa kawushshaaddu. Iza taman s'uugettaade hayk'k'u.

« ‹K'eesiyaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu, Aa huup'iyaan okettiyaa zayitii gukkeedda dirawunne I k'eesetetsaa mayuwaa mayyanaw dummateedda asaa gidiyaa diraw, bare huup'iyaa binnaanaa kallo wotsoppo; woy bare mayuwaakka peed'oppo.
Ay anhaa gidooppekka, de'iyaa sa'aa I geloppo; haray atto bare aawuwaa woy bare daay anhaa gidooppekka, barena hewaan tunissoppo.
Aa geeshshanaw okkiyaa S'oossaa zayitii Aa bollan de'iyaa diraw, k'eesii S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaappe kesoppo; S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaakka tunissoppo. Taani Med'inaa Godaa.
« ‹K'eesii wodoro mac'c'a naatto akko.
Asinay hayk'k'eedda mishirato, woy asinay yeddeedda mishirato, woy woshumaa mishirato akkoppo. Shin bare asaa giddoppe wodoro mac'c'a naatto dooriide akko.
Yaanana d'ayooppe, I bare asaa giddon bare zeretsaa gidiyaa bare naanatuwaa tunissana. Taani Aa geeshshiyaawe, med'inaa Godaa yaaga› » yaageedda.
Med'inaa Goday Musa, hawaadan yaageedda;
«Neeni Aaroonaw hawaadan yaagaade oda; ‹Sintsanna yiyaa ne zeretsaappe bollay tilla gidenna Asay ooninne k'umaa yarshshuwaa taw immanaw shiik'oppo.
Ayaw gooppe bollay tilla gidenna Asay ooninne shiik'anaw bessena. K'ook'a, woy wobba, woy demuu narp'p'etteedda, woy pac'a bollay de'iyaa asay,
woy gediyaa woy kushiyaa silay,
woy k'uunay, woy dinkkii, woy ayfii sakkiyaa asay, woy puussuu oyk'k'eedda asay, woy ilahuu oyk'k'eedda asay, woy goyro gidinakka bollay tilla gidenna asay, ooninne shiik'oppo.

K'eesiyaa Aaroona zariyaappe bollay tilla gidenna Asay ooninne Med'inaa Godaw taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa shiishshanaw shiik'oppo. Aw bollay tilla gidennawaa gidowaappe hini baggan, bare S'oossaw k'umaa yarshshuwaa shiishshanaw I bessena.
I geeshsha k'umaanne k'ay geeshsha ubbaappe ittuwaa gideedda geeshsha yarshshuwaa bare S'oossaa k'umaakka maanaw danddayee.
Shin aw bollay tilla gidenna diraw, I ta Dunkkaaniyaa tunissennaadan, gaaridduwaakko woy yarshshiyaa sa'aakko shiik'oppo. Ayaw gooppe, unttuntta geeshshiyaawe taani Med'inaa Godaa yaaga› » yaageedda.
Muse Aaroonaw, Aa attuma naanawunne Israa'eeliyaa asaw ubbaw hawaa odeedda.
